services.name: Standard passport — 32 pages / 5 years
services.jurisdiction: Nigeria and diaspora
services.description: Standard Nigerian passport option for fresh, renewal/reissue and applicable correction workflows.
requirements: NIN slip or Nigerian identity evidence as specified by NIS.
Birth certificate or declaration of age from a High Court.
Local Government or State of Origin/Indigene Certificate where required.
ICAO-compliant passport photograph.
processSteps: Complete the application online, upload the required documents, pay through the official portal and book an appointment.
Submit the payment and appointment slips in person at the selected passport office.
Attend photograph and biometric data capture; diaspora applicants use the nearest Nigerian Embassy, High Commission or Consulate.
services.notes: Fresh/change-data timeline is 42 days after successful enrolment; renewal/reissue is 21 days after successful enrolment. Prices exclude bank charges.
